name: Goal24 Checkpoint 5 Lane A - Skill Registry V1 Core + Safety Inheritance Hardening
base_note: origin/dev/goal24-cli-skills, verified exact after git fetch --all --tags --prune
commit_sha_note: docs commit that records this checkpoint; the manifest itself is committed as the branch tip immediately after

commits.message: feat(skills): add persistent skill registry v1
test(skills): harden registry trust and version semantics

conflict_policy_default: canonical effective value of an undeclared conflict_policy is reject (effectiveConflictPolicy, CP2.2); the old skill-side '?? allow' guess is removed
conflict_policy_ordering: allow(0) < warn(1) < reject(2); effective skill policy must be >= effective capability policy (skills may strengthen, never weaken)
verification_ordering: none(0) < asserted(1) < verified(2); canonical default undefined -> none via exported effectiveVerificationRequirement; effective skill requirement must be >= effective capability requirement
other_inheritance_preserved: mandatory capability evidence must exist in the skill with mandatory=true
capability freshness_policy requires skill max_age_ms <= capability max_age_ms
skill risk must be >= the highest referenced capability risk

registry.persistence_model: deterministic JSON store { schema_version: 1, updated_at, records[] }; atomic temp -> write -> fsync -> close -> rename; strict reads fail closed with SKILL_REGISTRY_CORRUPT; ENOENT = first-run empty store; path injected via constructor/open, never hardcoded
registry.digest_policy: lowercase SHA-256 hex (64 chars) only; MD5 and SHA-1 rejected by schema

builtin_default_trust: quarantined unless the separately defined trusted built-in policy predicate explicitly allows trusted for that builtin
adapter_preference_authority: preference only; never overrides capability authority, evidence, risk, executable or argv

coverage: conflict ordering matrix (cap undefined+warn+reject x skill allow/warn/reject/undefined)
valid register / invalid manifest / unknown input fields / missing capability / risk weakening / evidence weakening
trust promotion mechanism enforcement and provenance requirements
builtin-policy trust and imported/local default quarantined
persistence reload, corrupt store fail-closed, unknown persisted fields, duplicate persisted identities, first-run empty store

verification.lint: PASS (0 errors; only pre-existing warnings outside this lane; no warnings in CP5 files)
verification.static_no_execution_scan: PASS (no child_process/exec/execFile/spawn/shell/Command/powershell/cmd.exe/bash/sh -c in the four CP5 source files)

known_residual_risks: Registry accepts digests from the future importer; it does not read the package filesystem itself, so importer hashing correctness is a later-checkpoint concern
Stored records are registration-time snapshots; eligibility re-validates against the live capability lookup at read time
setTrustStatus is an internal service API; any later MCP/Tauri wiring requires its own security gate
builtinTrustedPolicy is applied only to source_type == builtin registrations

environment.policy: D: first, then existing C:; new installs only under D:\environment
